# Laurent Curau

> Laurent Curau is an independent software engineer in Monaco. He embeds AI in a company's workflows, documents and data, in a secure way. He also builds websites, online shops and internal tools.

The site is in French (default) and in English (under /en/). Laurent is Monégasque, lives and works in Monaco, and holds an MSc in Software Engineering from the University of Oxford. Contact: hello@laurentcurau.com, or the WhatsApp button on each page.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://laurentcurau.com/en/): what the AI integration service is, how it works and how it stays secure
- [FAQ](https://laurentcurau.com/en/faq/): upfront and ongoing cost, data protection and cybersecurity
- [About Laurent](https://laurentcurau.com/en/about/): background, way of working and contact
- [Portfolio](https://laurentcurau.com/en/portfolio/): sites and tools built for clients

## Case studies

- [Agence de la Gare](https://laurentcurau.com/en/case-study/agence-de-la-gare/): a Monaco real estate site in nine languages
- [Maison de Bacon](https://laurentcurau.com/en/case-study/maison-de-bacon/): a restaurant site redesign
- [Christian Curau Architecte](https://laurentcurau.com/en/case-study/christian-curau-architecte/): an architect's site and file sharing tool
